label: rem:hecke-blitvic-pair-partition-mechanism
title: Why the Markov-trace moments are not a pair-partition sum
html: Blitvić's theorem applies when joint moments of centred variables vanish in odd degree and decompose as a sum over pair-partitions in even degree. For the Hecke generators under the Markov trace the first condition already fails: the third centred moment of a single generator is non-zero (the Blitvić-hypothesis proposition). The quadratic relation reduces a repeated generator to a combination of 1 and \sigma_i, not to a pairing, so the Markov-trace moments are not a pair-partition sum.
